description: This donut chart, from the paper "$M^3EL$ A Multi-task Multi-topic Dataset for Multi-modal Entity Linking," visually represents the distribution of four distinct topics within the dataset, shown as four colored slices with labeled percentages: the largest slice, colored light blue, accounts for 41.2% and is labeled “Moive” (likely a misspelling of “Movie”); the second largest, colored pink, represents 30.5% and is labeled “Person”; the third, colored light green, represents 14.9%; and the smallest, colored light yellow, represents 9.1% and is labeled “Book.” A fifth category, “Sport,” is also listed in the legend as a gray color but does not appear as a visible slice in the chart, instead showing only a 4.3% value in a separate legend entry. The chart includes a central legend titled “Topics” that maps each category to its corresponding color, and percentage values are displayed directly on the respective slices. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, starting from the top right and moving clockwise.
